recent_changes: last was v1.3 26.4h ago, which doesn't match the incident timing
args.impact: Up to 36 orders were stuck in the queue at peak (26067.47 SAR total queued, as reported by the tool). All were processed with payment after the restart. 0 dropped, 0 unpaid, 0 ledger failures.
recommended_actions: Investigate why the worker stalled while its heartbeat stayed fresh, and add an alert on processed throughput versus enqueued.
args.summary: The queue backlog came from a stalled worker. It kept a fresh heartbeat but stopped processing at 14 orders. Restarting it drained the queue, and all 86 orders now have payments. check_invariants is green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown, so the stall could happen again.
